definition_zh: 不把统计规律当终点，而是将「经验规律」与「物理机理」双向锚定：用机理解释规律为何成立、用规律约束机理模型参数，使预测既来自数据又能在因果上解释，提升可解释性与鲁棒性。
definition_en: Do not treat statistical law as the endpoint; instead dual-anchor 'empirical law' and 'physical mechanism': use mechanism to explain why the law holds, and use the law to constrain mechanism-model parameters, so prediction comes from data yet is causally explainable—raising interpretability and robustness.

formulas: Law: y = f(data)   [经验规律：数据拟合]
Mechanism: dy/dt = M(θ, x)   [物理机理：动力学方程，θ 为参数]
Dual-anchor: θ* = argmin_θ [ ‖f(data)−y_sim(θ)‖ + λ·R(θ) ]   [以规律约束机理参数]
Explainability E ↑ when both hold; robustness ρ ↑ under covariate shift

variables.θ: 机理模型参数（由规律反约束）
variables.λ: 规律对机理的约束权重

formula_repr.prototype: System thinking / 系统思维法（经验↔机理双向校验版）

triggers: 有统计相关性但说不清「为什么」，难以外推
机理性模型参数过多、需实证锚定
预测须可解释、可被审计（科研/监管/医疗）
数据分布可能漂移，纯数据规律易失效
anti_patterns: 只报相关系数 R² 高就当成因果结论
机理模型自成体系、不与经验规律对表
用规律硬套超出其时空域的外推
为可解释牺牲精度到不可用的程度

steps_zh: 提经验规律：先从数据/物候归纳出可复现的统计规律（如物候期随积温推移）。
建机理模型：给出物理/动力学解释框架（光温水耦合、太阳辐射—火山—温室气体）。
双向锚定：以经验规律反约束机理参数 θ，使仿真输出与观测吻合。
机理解释：用机理回答「为何」——规律不再是黑箱，而是可因果解读。
域外检验：在规律未覆盖的时空（如格陵兰、欧洲）验证机理是否仍成立。
迭代收紧：新数据进来则重标 θ，使规律与机理共同进化、互不脱节。
steps_en: Elicit empirical law: induce a reproducible statistical law from data/phenology (e.g. phenophase vs accumulated temperature).
Build mechanism model: give the physical/dynamic explanatory frame (light–water–temperature coupling; solar–volcanic–greenhouse).
Dual-anchor: use the empirical law to constrain mechanism parameters θ so simulation matches observation.
Explain via mechanism: answer 'why'—the law is no longer a black box but causally readable.
Out-of-domain test: verify the mechanism where the law was not sampled (Greenland, Europe).
Iterative tightening: new data re-anchors θ so law and mechanism co-evolve without drifting apart.
historical_case_zh: 竺可桢的物候研究把「物候期与积温关系」（经验规律）与「光温水耦合模型」（物理机理）双向锚定；其《中国近五千年气候变迁》既由史料归纳出冷暖轮廓，又用太阳辐射变化、火山活动、CO₂/CH₄ 等机理支撑，使「竺可桢曲线」既是史实归纳也可机理解读。早年台风研究亦以数百个台风观测资料归纳分类，再置于气象动力学机理中解释起源与转向。
historical_case_en: Zhu's phenology work dual-anchors 'phenophase vs accumulated-temperature' (empirical law) with 'light–water–temperature coupling' (physical mechanism); his 5000-year climate study induces a warm/cold contour from archives yet supports it with solar variability, volcanism, CO₂/CH₄ mechanisms, so the 'Zhu Kezhen curve' is both historical induction and mechanically interpretable. His early typhoon work归纳 hundreds of observations then explains origin/turning within meteorological dynamics.
modern_case_zh: 可解释 AI/机理模型：用神经网络提规律、用物理方程约束（PINN）；药物研发用靶点机理解释统计疗效；工程故障用机理树解读传感器相关性——皆同此模式。
modern_case_en: Explainable AI / mechanistic modeling: neural nets induce law, physics equations constrain (PINN); drug R&D explains statistical efficacy via target mechanism; engineering faults read sensor correlations through a mechanism tree—all the same pattern.
inheritance_note: B 级结构同构：对应系统思维（模式 12）在组织/战略系统的整体协调用法。A 级直链：竺可桢是 Protreptic 中将模式 12 聚焦到「经验规律↔物理机理双向校验」、以可解释性为目标的科学系统思维第一人，补强模式 12 高频核心。
reason_zh: 竺可桢将模式 12（系统思维法）用于经验规律与物理机理的双向锚定，使气候预测既有数据支撑又可因果解释，是科学可解释性维度的系统思维。
reason_en: Zhu maps mode 12 (system thinking) onto dual-anchoring empirical law and physical mechanism, so climate prediction is both data-backed and causally explainable—system thinking aimed at scientific interpretability.
expected_zh: 产出既可解释又可外推的规律—机理耦合模型，在数据分布漂移时仍保持鲁棒，且参数经经验规律反约束不过拟合。
expected_en: Produce a law–mechanism coupled model that is both explainable and extrapolable, robust under covariate shift, with parameters反-constrained by empirical law so as not to overfit.
digital_adaptation: Maps to physics-informed neural networks (PINN) and mechanistic-explainable AI.
author: serrano
cross_cultural_impact: Applicable to global earth-system science, observation-network design, long-horizon climate reconstruction, and resilience of academic institutions under crisis
education_tradition: Modern science / 现代科学教育（求是书院—浙大传统）
source_lineage: 《中国近五千年来气候变迁的初步研究》(考古学报 1972(1))
